appropriate visualization of appropriate dominant nodule on the
right, the skin adjacent to the probe was prepped with alcohol.

alcohol. Cytolyt and slides sent to Southeastern Pathology.  After
confirming no bleeding at FNA sight or within thyroid, a sterile band-aid
was placed.  Patient was instructed to avoid lifting or heavy exercise for
24 hours.  Patient to call for any severe or worsening throat pain or
difficulty breathing.   Patient to be contacted by Dr. Jalagani with
results and recommendations.
